title: Expose a finite nonlinear identification construction with its acquisition costs
statement: The acquired working classical complex-amplitude one-port construction uses a globally switchable onsite cubic force, actual linear modal acquisition and paired finite nonlinear pulses.3nvector polarization queries acquire a symmetric slice whose separated eigenvectors identify physical coordinates up to port-preserving signed permutation, with explicit finite-pulse/measurement/conditioning debits. Two six-site floating examples are the executed evidence.

requires: The actual six-site cyclic real-symmetric source and one-port complex field/control interface
Qualified frequency/port-weight/conditioning and supplied distributed Kerr actuation
provides: The supplied finite floating experiment reconstructs two six-site real symmetric cyclic Hamiltonian sources related by an orthogonal port-fixing gauge, using one-port complex fields, linear frequency/control acquisition and a distributed Kerr pulse. Distributed nonlinear slices differ where the displayed off/port-only/isotropic controls agree; shorter pulses reduce the displayed aligned reconstruction error. One finite simulated model, not a general algorithmic capability or novelty result. Actual frequency gaps, port weights, Hankel/readout/control conditioning, supplied distributed nonlinear primitive, pulse extrapolation and ignored imaginary/antisymmetric components are paid.113calls/684portreads per instance plus preparation/readout/pulse work are reported; elapsed Python time is not physical runtime. No finite-error certificate or hardware. The laterN596/N597source pointer was delivered AFTER this early experiment; those prior constructions retain their own stability/conditioning disagreement and access models.
assumptions: This is a CLASSICAL complex-amplitude ODE, not an exact quantum Kerr expectation equation. Mathematical/code challenge is pending. Distributed interior actuation, complex phase-referenced port control/readout, cyclic simple unaliased spectrum, minimum visible weight, qualified slice eigengap, paid reset and all preparation/readout precision are premises. Small pulses amplify raw measurement error; no acquired physical confidence/capability, apparatus or novelty. N596/N597were read AFTER the first experiment and have different acquired conditioning/access contracts; the finite linear/port-only/isotropic controls do not establish an all-method advantage.
